source_refs.note: Book p. 37-38: 3.3.1 Absolute Value Quadratic Equations, Example 5 with its two-column Check; callouts marked Teaching note / Key points / Common mistake and the Book correction box are ours.

blocks.text: Pichle page par hum ne absolute value ke rules seekhe. Ab inhein quadratic expression ke saath lagate hain. Aisi equation jis mein \(|\ \ |\) ke andar quadratic expression ho, jaise \(|x^{2} - 4| = 5\), absolute value quadratic equation kehlati hai. Is ka hal do aam quadratic equations mein toot jata hai, jo aap pehle se hal karna jaante hain.

Absolute value quadratic equations hal karte waqt tamam jawabon ko asal equation mein wapas rakh kar dekhna zaroori hai ke woh durust hain ya nahi. Kabhi kabhi "extraneous" hal (yani aise jawab jo working se nikal aate hain magar asal equation ko poora nahi karte) saamne aa jate hain; yeh durust nahi hote aur inhein aakhri jawab se nikaalna zaroori hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(|ax^{2} + bx + c| = d\) hal karne ka tareeqa (hamari taraf se):
1. Agar \(d < 0\) ho: koi hal nahi, kyun ke absolute value kabhi negative nahi hoti. Kaam yahin khatam.
2. Agar \(d \ge 0\) ho: \(ax^{2} + bx + c = d\) ya \(ax^{2} + bx + c = -d\) likhein.
3. Dono quadratic equations hal karein (factorization ya quadratic formula). Sirf real roots rakhein.
4. Har root ko asal equation mein rakhein aur jo fail ho use nikaal dein.
Extraneous hal woh number hai jo working se paida hota hai lekin asal equation ko poora nahi karta. Yeh khaas tor par tab aata hai jab right side par bhi \(x\) ho (jaise neeche hamari misaal mein), kyun ke tab "\(d \ge 0\)" khud ba khud yaqeeni nahi hota.

blocks.title: Example 5
steps:
Given: \(|x^{2} - 4| = 5\).
To find: woh tamam real \(x\) jo equation ko poora karein.
Method: sab se pehle sochiye ke \(|\ \ |\) ke andar wala expression kya ho sakta hai. Absolute value 5 tab hoti hai jab andar wala hissa \(5\) ho ya \(-5\). Is tarah humein do aam quadratic equations milengi jin mein absolute value ki lakeerein nahi hongi. Dono hal karenge, phir har jawab ko asal equation mein rakh kar check karenge.

Step 1: Absolute value hatayein
\[|x^{2} - 4| = 5\]
\[x^{2} - 4 = \pm 5\]
Kyun: \(|E| = 5\) ka matlab hai ke \(E\) zero se 5 unit door hai, yani \(E = 5\) ya \(E = -5\). Yeh 3.3 wala pehla rule hai. Yahan \(E = x^{2} - 4\) hai.

Step 2: Do cases likhein
\[x^{2} - 4 = 5 \;\text{ ya }\; x^{2} - 4 = -5\]
\[x^{2} = 9 \;\text{ ya }\; x^{2} = -1\]
Kyun: har equation mein dono taraf 4 jama kiya, taa ke \(x^{2}\) akela reh jaye.

Step 3: Har case hal karein
\[x = \pm 3 \;\text{ ya }\; x = \pm\sqrt{-1}\]
\(\pm\sqrt{-1}\) imaginary hai, is liye chhor diya.
Kyun: \(x^{2} = 9\) ke do real roots hain, \(3\) aur \(-3\), kyun ke dono ka square 9 hai. \(x^{2} = -1\) ka koi real root nahi, kyun ke kisi real number ka square negative nahi hota. Hum real \(x\) dhoond rahe hain (3.3 mein absolute value real numbers ke liye define hui hai), is liye \(\pm i\) hal mein shamil nahi.
Dilchasp baat: \(x = i\) rakhein to \(x^{2} - 4 = -5\) aur \(|-5| = 5\) banta hai; algebra ke hisaab se yeh bhi chal jata hai. Lekin sawal real numbers ka hai, is liye kitab ise "imaginary" keh kar nikaal deti hai.

Step 4: Tasdeeq (wapas rakh kar dekhein)
\(x = 3\) ke liye:
\[|3^{2} - 4| = 5\]
\[|5| = 5 \Rightarrow 5 = 5\]
\(x = -3\) ke liye:
\[|(-3)^{2} - 4| = 5\]
\[|5| = 5 \Rightarrow 5 = 5\]
Kyun: kitab ne shuru mein hi kaha tha ke absolute value equations mein har jawab wapas rakhna zaroori hai, taa ke koi extraneous (faltu, ghalat) hal reh na jaye. Yahan dono values sahi nikleen.
Dhyan dein: \(-3\) ka square lete waqt bracket zaroor lagayein: \((-3)^{2} = 9\).

Step 5: Solution set likhein
Is liye solution set \(= \{\pm 3\}\), yani \(\{-3, 3\}\).
Kyun: sirf woh real values rakhi jo check mein paas huin.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: \(x = -3\) ke check mein kitab \(|(-3^{2}) - 4| = 5\) chhapti hai. Jaisa likha hai, \(-3^{2} = -9\) banta hai (pehle square, phir minus), aur \(|-9 - 4| = 13\), jo 5 nahi. Bracket mein poora \(-3\) hona chahiye: \(|(-3)^{2} - 4| = |9 - 4| = 5\). Nateeja, ke \(x = -3\) hal hai, durust hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari misaal hai, kitab ka sawal nahi. Is mein check waqai kaam aata hai: \(|x^{2} - 4| = 3x\).
Case 1: \(x^{2} - 4 = 3x\), yani \(x^{2} - 3x - 4 = 0\), \((x - 4)(x + 1) = 0\), \(x = 4\) ya \(x = -1\).
Case 2: \(x^{2} - 4 = -3x\), yani \(x^{2} + 3x - 4 = 0\), \((x + 4)(x - 1) = 0\), \(x = -4\) ya \(x = 1\).
Ab chaaron ko check karein: \(x = 4\): \(|12| = 12\) aur \(3(4) = 12\), sahi. \(x = 1\): \(|-3| = 3\) aur \(3(1) = 3\), sahi. \(x = -1\): \(|-3| = 3\) magar \(3(-1) = -3\), ghalat, yeh extraneous hai. \(x = -4\): \(|12| = 12\) magar \(3(-4) = -12\), yeh bhi extraneous.
Solution set \(= \{1, 4\}\). Agar check na karte to do ghalat jawab bhi likh dete. Wajah: left side hamesha \(\ge 0\) hai, is liye right side \(3x\) bhi \(\ge 0\) honi chahiye; negative \(x\) yahan mumkin hi nahi.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
\(|x^{2} - 1| = -2\) ke kitne hal hain? Hal karne se pehle sochiye.
Jawab: ek bhi nahi. Absolute value kabhi \(-2\) jaisi negative value nahi le sakti. Aise sawal mein lambi working ki zaroorat hi nahi; seedha likhiye "no solution", yani solution set \(\{\ \}\) (khaali set).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(|E| = d\) (jab \(d \ge 0\)) do cases mein toot jata hai: \(E = d\) ya \(E = -d\).
2. Har case ek aam quadratic equation hai.
3. Non-real (imaginary) roots chhor dein; hum real numbers mein hal kar rahe hain.
4. Har jawab ko asal equation mein wapas rakhein aur extraneous hal nikaal dein.
5. Check mein negative value ka square lene se pehle bracket lagayein: \((-3)^{2} = 9\).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Sirf \(E = d\) hal karna aur \(E = -d\) bhool jana; is se aadhe jawab ghayab ho jate hain.
2. \((-3)^{2}\) ki jagah \(-3^{2}\) likhna: \(-3^{2} = -9\), magar \((-3)^{2} = 9\).
3. Real equation ke jawab mein \(x = \pm\sqrt{-1}\) rakh lena.
4. Jab right side par \(x\) ho tab check chhor dena: bilkul isi waqt extraneous hal aate hain.
